components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid pine action that moves visitors into selected work.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:46px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:0 17px; border:1px solid var(--pine); background:var(--pine); color:#fff; font:700 12px Manrope, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:transform .2s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.2,1), background .2s, border-color .2s; } .ds-button-primary:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); border-color:var(--pine-dark); background:var(--pine-dark); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--brass); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Text Action

components.css: .ds-project { display:flex; min-height:300px; flex-direction:column; padding:25px 27px 23px; background:var(--paper-raised); color:var(--ink); } .ds-project-status { align-self:flex-end; padding:4px 7px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong); color:var(--pine); font:8px 'DM Mono', Consolas, monospace; } .ds-project h3 { margin:24px 0 12px; font:700 24px/1.1 Manrope, sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.05em; } .ds-project p { max-width:65ch; color:var(--muted); font:11px/1.65 Manrope, sans-serif; }

components.name: Engineering System Map
components.description: Four solid technology blocks show the portfolio's Android, services, native, and data layers.
components.css: .ds-map { padding:16px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong); background:var(--paper-raised); color:var(--ink); } .ds-map figcaption { padding-bottom:14px; color:var(--muted); font:9px 'DM Mono', Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing:.05em; } .ds-map-canvas { position:relative; display:grid; min-height:360px; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; grid-template-rows:1fr 1fr; gap:18%; align-items:center; padding:8%; border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--paper); } .ds-map-canvas svg { position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; } .ds-map-canvas path { fill:none; stroke:var(--line-strong); stroke-width:1.5; } .ds-node { z-index:1; display:flex; min-height:84px; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; padding:10px; font:700 13px Manrope, sans-serif; transition:transform .85s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.2,1); } .ds-node small { margin-top:4px; font:9px Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-node-mobile { background:var(--pine); color:#fff; } .ds-node-services { background:var(--soft-paper); color:var(--ink); } .ds-node-native { background:var(--native-block); color:#fff; } .ds-node-data { background:var(--brass-block); color:#2c2c20; } .ds-map[data-state="breaking"] .ds-node-mobile { transform:translate(-10px,-12px); } .ds-map[data-state="breaking"] .ds-node-services { transform:translate(10px,-12px); } .ds-map[data-state="breaking"] .ds-node-native { transform:translate(-10px,12px); } .ds-map[data-state="breaking"] .ds-node-data { transform:translate(10px,12px); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-node { transform:none !important; transition:none !important; } }

narrative.overview: The portfolio treats engineering as a connected set of decisions. Warm paper and deep ink keep the reading experience calm, while the hero's four-part flow map makes the Android, Spring Boot, native integration, and data layers visible at a glance. Project details and evidence stay in the foreground; the diagram frames the work instead of impersonating a person or product screenshot. The page uses solid fields, thin rules, and compact technical labels to give the work an editorial structure. The map and small material markers assemble and separate as visitors scroll. Every text block stays readable in each state, and reduced-motion preferences leave the geometry stable.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper surfaces, deep ink, muted pine, and brass.
Manrope for reading and DM Mono for dates, categories, technologies, and measured facts.
A labeled architecture map in the first viewport in place of portrait or avatar artwork.
Flat panels, square material blocks, thin rules, and restrained scroll motion.

rules.name: The Solid Fields Rule
rules.body: Separate information with solid color fields and thin rules; avoid neon, gradients, and decorative blur.

rules.name: The Measured Label Rule
rules.body: Use monospace for code, dates, categories, technologies, and measurements; use Manrope for prose and headings.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Use tonal surfaces and borders for separation; do not add ornamental shadows or blur to panels.

rules.name: The Assembly Rule
rules.body: Move map geometry and small section markers only; keep all copy visible, and hold the map still when reduced motion is preferred.

dos: Do use the paper, ink, pine, and brass roles from the frontmatter for new surfaces.
Do use Manrope for reading and DM Mono only for technical labels and measured context.
Do keep the system map factual and the text readable while its parts move.
Do honor reduced-motion preferences with a stable arrangement.
donts: Don't add a portrait or avatar graphic; the user chose an engineering diagram instead.
Don't use neon colors, gradients, or decorative blur.
Don't use rounded cards or ornamental shadows; the page's surfaces are flat and square.
